title: FanDuel Promo Code: Bet $5, Get $200 When You Bet on the NBA, NHL, and Thursday Night Football

The next four days cover just about everything. Wednesday brings a strong NBA slate and a full NHL schedule, Thursday opens NFL Week 11, Friday has more NBA action and Saturday is college football. FanDuel is giving new users $200 in bonus bets by betting $5 a day for four days, with no promo code required.

This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting partners. If you sign up or place a wager, FOX News may be compensated. This content was created by a team that works independently from the FOX newsroom.

How to Sign Up and Claim the FanDuel Sportsbook Welcome Bonus

Visit FanDuel, download the app or click the offer button. No promo code is needed.

Create a new account and complete registration and the geolocation check.

Once your account is verified, deposit at least $5.

Place a $5 or more wager on any NBA, NHL or NFL game.

Receive $50 in bonus bets, win or lose, once the wager settles.

Bet $5 or more each day for four straight days to collect $200 in bonus bets.

Bonus bets expire after seven days.

For more information, review the FanDuel promo code page.

Day 1 (Wednesday): NBA and NHL

The NBA’s late window features Celtics at Nuggets at 9 p.m. ET and Warriors at Mavericks at 9:30 p.m. ET, with Bucks at Heat opening the night on ESPN.

Wednesday’s Pick: Nikola Jokic Over His Assists Line. Boston will send help at Jokic all night, and that’s when he does his best work as a passer. Double teams create open cutters and shooters, and at home, Jokic will find them over and over. Use your first $5 on his assists.

Day 2 (Thursday): Thursday Night Football

Colts vs Texans | Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026 at 8:15 p.m. ET | NRG Stadium, Houston, TX | Prime Video

Week 11 kicks off with an AFC South rivalry. Houston opened as a home favorite against Indianapolis, and division games on short weeks tend to be physical, low-margin battles.

Odds are subject to change

Moneyline

Spread

Total

Thursday’s Pick: Colts +5.5. Short weeks limit game plans, and division rivals know each other’s tendencies well. That usually keeps games tight, and 5.5 points is a lot of room in a familiar matchup. Use your second $5 on the Colts and the points.

Day 3 (Friday): NBA

Friday’s NBA slate gives you plenty of options for your third $5 bet.

Day 4 (Saturday): College Football

A full Saturday of college football is the perfect place to lock in your final $50 in bonus bets.

How It Works

Four days, four $5 bets, four $50 bonus bet drops. Win or lose, each bet earns $50 in bonus bets once it settles, as long as you place one every day. You can switch sports from night to night and follow the best matchup each day.

Start with Wednesday’s NBA and NHL action and finish with college football Saturday. New users can bet $5 a day for four days with FanDuel and collect $200 in bonus bets.
